title: Qt: Contiguous selection in IOGraphs
description:
Enable copying, removing, moving up, and moving down a contiguous
selection range of the IOGraphs. The drag and drop support already
works with contiguous selection mode.

commits_data.title: Qt: Contiguous selection in IOGraphs
commits_data.message:
Qt: Contiguous selection in IOGraphs

Enable copying, removing, moving up, and moving down a contiguous
selection range.

commits_data.title: UAT: Add a function to remove multiple records
commits_data.message:
UAT: Add a function to remove multiple records

This is more efficient than calling uat_remove_record_idx
multiple times because the underlying GArrays can do one
memmove.

Use the function in UatModel removeRows to support passing
in more than one row at once.  The views don't use this yet.

Switch to QVectors for dirty_records and record_errors.
This is exactly the same thing on Qt6, but on Qt5 QLists
don't have a function to remove count items starting at an index.
